audience.who: Chinese-speaking compiler engineers comfortable with MLIR concepts and English identifiers, who have not read MergeVecScope.cpp
audience.goal: understand the full control/state lifecycle of greedy VF merging: how candidates are scheduled (worklist vs live order), what exactly is updated after a successful merge and where, and which rejections happen before vs inside tryMerge

learning_objectives: Explain why VF call overhead motivates merging, in one sentence
Distinguish startVFs (candidate worklist) from vfs (current live call order) and predict where a merged VF lands in each
Separate outer-loop pre-checks (liveness / last-in-order / L1 related / chain limit) from tryMerge legality gates
State which states a successful merge updates, at which code site (patchCalls vs outer commit), and which state is initialization-only (score matrix)
Explain chaining as worklist re-entry (merged VF requeued to the tail), not recursion at the success point
State the delayed-deletion contract: old calls erased in patchCalls, old VF functions erased only after the loop

storyline.claim: 小 kernel 被 outline 成很多小 VF，vector core 每次 call 都要付调度开销，小 kernel 上这笔开销占主导
把 call 相邻的 VF 对融成一个 merged VF，调度成本只付一次；安全性靠依赖/内存效应分析证明，不靠猜测
merge-level 实为二选一：L1 在 bufferization 前融合 tensor 级 VF，L2 在其后融合 memref 级 VF
七个源码阶段全景：一次性分析（收集/依赖/打分）→ 候选 worklist 循环（预检查→闸门→改写→维护）→ 提交与延迟删除；Maintain & verify 是显式阶段，不折叠进贪心循环
一次成功合并的状态账本：allDepsClosure 在 patchCalls 内更新、VFDependencyGraph 在外层提交更新、vfs/startVFs/numVFInMergedVF/toRemoveVFs 在外层提交更新；useScoreMat 初始化后只读
A+B 成功后：AB 占回 A 槽位、追加 startVFs 尾部；轮到 AB 时在当前 vfs=[AB,C] 里重新定位——链式 = worklist 再入，不是递归
useScoreMat 标记前向使用，0 分 VF stable_partition 排先进 startVFs；循环只看 live 序列右邻
两段拒绝分清：外层预检查（不在 vfs/末尾/L1 相关/超限）在 tryMerge 之前；tryMerge 闸门（相邻/同 region/extract-kind/同步/锚点）一票否决
gap 空 → mergeNoBetween 纯拼接；gap 非空 → mergeNoMemory 折叠；patchCalls 擦除旧调用并同步闭包；旧 VF 函数延迟到循环后删除
attention fixture 实测：两个相邻 tensor 级 VF call → 一个 4 结果 merged call（真实执行）
单调用假设无守护（MVS-001）；跨块依赖不可见（MVS-002）；merge-level=0 完全关闭
两个窗口、两个序列、两段拒绝、两类删除、一份只读分数矩阵——控制流与状态生命周期各归其位

key_takeaways: 两个窗口：L1 在 bufferize 前合 tensor 级 VF（一套 buffer），L2 在其后合 memref 级 VF（可折叠间隔代码）。
startVFs 是候选 worklist，vfs 是当前调用序 live 状态——成功合并把 merged 占回 vf1 槽位并追加到 startVFs 尾部稍后处理，不是立即递归。
每轮成功合并后真正同步的是 allDepsClosure（patchCalls 内）、VFDependencyGraph（外层提交）和 vfs/startVFs/numVFInMergedVF/toRemoveVFs（外层提交）；useScoreMat/useScoreTotal 只在初始化打分时构建，之后只读。
两段拒绝：外层预检查发生在 tryMerge 之前；tryMerge 闸门一票否决——宁可漏合不可错合。
删除分两步：旧调用在 patchCalls 内擦除；旧 VF 函数延迟到 while 结束后经 toRemoveVFs 统一 func.erase。

evidence_index.statement: Pass identity and options: def MergeVecScope : Pass<"hfusion-merge-vf", "ModuleOp">, summary 'Merge vf function', constructor mlir::hfusion::createMergeVecScopePass(); options merge-level (int, default 1; '0: no merge; 1: merge VFs only without dependency; 2: merge all VFs') and merge-vf-num-limit (int, default 4, 'allowed maximum number of merged VFs').
Subject collection: runOnOperation walks the module collecting funcs where hivm::isVF(f) into vfs; the root is the single non-VF func found by the same walk; without a root the pass returns early.

VF ordering: root.walk over func.call ops collects callees in first-call order; vfs is reordered to that call order with never-called VFs appended after (comment: 'the first function call the VF should be first').

Dependency facts are same-block only: SSA deps recorded when defOp->getBlock() == op->getBlock() (:557); memref Read/Write deps short-circuit on op1->getBlock() != op2->getBlock() (:583); combined deps then go through computeDependencyClosure (:609).

Scoring: useScoreMat[i][j]=1 marks forward usage when any call pair of vf_i/vf_j is dependency-related via isDep on the closure; useScoreTotal drives stable_partition so dependency-free VFs merge first; VFDependencyGraph is filled from the score matrix.

Greedy merge loop: for each startVFs entry in call-ordered position, candidate pair is (vfs[i], vfs[i+1]); mergeLevel==1 skips pairs where vfDependencyGraph.areRelated; pairs are skipped when numVFInMergedVF sums exceed mergeVFNumLimit; on tryMerge success the merged VF replaces the pair, is re-queued into startVFs, vfDependencyGraph.mergeNodes rewires, and both old VFs are collected into toRemoveVFs and erased after the loop; final LLVM_DEBUG logs 'Number of VFs before/after'.

tryMerge legality gates: needs call1/call2 found adjacent in the root walk; hasCompatibleResultExtractKind must pass; both calls must share getParentRegion(); any hivm::SyncBlockSetOp/SyncBlockWaitOp in the gap rejects ('temporarily regard sync_block instr as memory op'); anchor-bearing gap ops are pinned (SSA-neighbor closure) and a pinned result feeding call2 rejects; gap mem ops must be movable (moveAfterVf2 / moveBeforeVf1 by isDep, else SplitMove must succeed); at mergeLevel==1 any remaining unpinned gap ops reject.

mergeNoBetween rewrite: rejects mismatched func core types; builds merged func with unified args where vf2 block args fed by call1 results are remapped to vf1's results; clones vf1 body then vf2 body (without terminators) via IRMapping; concatenates returns; patchCalls creates one func.call with call1's args plus call2's non-duplicate args, sets ptc_simdvf unit attr, copies other call attrs, RAUWs both calls' results, updates allDepsClosure, erases both calls.

mergeNoMemory rewrite: for non-empty gaps, betweenInfo records {usedAfter, feedsVF2} per gap op; used-after intermediates become extra merged-func results and their external inputs extra args; gap mem ops are lifted into the merged function body between the cloned vf1/vf2 bodies; final call operands are vf1's + remaining vf2's + external inputs; used-after gap ops are erased after RAUW.

Self-verification and known soft spots in current HEAD: mergedFunc.verify() failure triggers signalPassFailure at MergeVecScope.cpp:1420-1422 (mergeNoMemory) and :1623-1625 (final); the assumption 'each vf is used only once' exists only as a comment at :631; same-block-only dependency scans at :557 and :583.

Pipeline placements: in HIVMRegbasePipelines.cpp the L1 placement adds createMergeVecScopePass(mergeLevel=1) only when hivmPipelineOptions.enableVfMergeLevel==1, before createSimplifyVFArgsPass and before tensor-copy-insertion/OneShotBufferize (:230-234); the L2 placement adds createMergeVecScopePass(mergeLevel=2) when enableVfMergeLevel==2, immediately after OneShotBufferize (:254-260) — the two placements are mutually exclusive by the same option.

Knowledge graph (mlir-repomap review MergeVecScope, index @ head 90037fe33): pass id pass:hfusion-merge-vf, summary 'Merge vf function', Passes.td:719; Phase-13 review record states the intent ('VF call overhead on vector cores dominates small-kernel execution; merging VFs amortizes per-call scheduling'), lists the verify guards as HAS_CONSTRAINT-enforced, names the single-use assumption as the UNGUARDED invariant, and records the same-block dependency scan as the coverage opportunity; two open findings MVS-001 (correctness) and MVS-002 (opportunity) link to this pass.

History: commit 4ddead06f (2026-07-15, '[Huawei][AscendNPU IR] migrate MergeVecScope from A5') introduced the file wholesale (1669 insertions); the knowledge memory's regression note says the single-use assumption came with the port and no fix has landed since.

Executed build/bin/bishengir-opt --hfusion-merge-vf="merge-level=1" -split-input-file on bishengir/test/Dialect/HIVM/RegBase/merge-vf-level-1.mlir (exit 0): the two adjacent tensor-level VF calls of the attention fixture become one call '%11:4 = call @_attn_fwd_outlined_merged_merged_vf_0(...)' returning 4 results, matching the file's CHECK; VFs of other scopes in the same fixture (e.g. _attn_fwd_scope_3_outlined_manual_vf_0) remain unmerged calls.

Executed build/bin/bishengir-opt --hfusion-merge-vf="merge-level=2" -split-input-file on bishengir/test/Dialect/HIVM/RegBase/merge-vf-level-2.mlir (exit 0): the merged function rms_norm_f32_split_n_with_vf_merge_outlined_merged__merged_vf_0 has memref-typed arguments and results, and the fused call carries {hivm.vector_function, no_inline, ptc_simdvf} — L2 output is post-bufferization memref IR.

Test corpus: merge-vf-level-1.mlir (CHECK expects the merged 4-result call) and merge-vf-level-2.mlir (memref form) under test/Dialect/HIVM/RegBase/; hfusion-merge-vf-dependency-update.mlir and hfusion-merge-vf-extract-kind.mlir under test/Dialect/HFusion/ cover dependency-graph updates and extract-kind gating respectively.

VFDependencyGraph keeps vfDeps (forward) and vfUsers (reverse) maps with self-edge rejection; mergeNodes(old1, old2, merged) unions adjacency of the two old nodes into the merged node and rewires neighbors' reverse edges; verify() asserts reverse-edge and self-edge consistency and is called under LLVM_DEBUG after every graph mutation.

Extract-kind gate rationale (in-code comment): 'Only merge VFs whose result are all extract or none extract. If one vf's result is extracted the other is not, extracted result will be converted V->S wait, which will prevent double buffering.'

Worklist requeue: on tryMerge success the merged VF is appended to the START-set worklist (startVFs.push_back(mergedVfRef.getOperation()), :801-802) while scoreIdx keeps advancing — the merged VF is reprocessed LATER through the worklist, never merged recursively at the success point.

Live-order commit: insertedPos aliases &vfs[vf1Idx] (:772); on success vfs[vf1Idx] becomes the merged VF and vf2, then vf1, are erased from vfs (:774-786) — the current call order shrinks in place and the merged VF occupies the old vf1 slot.

Deferred deletion: old VF objects are collected into toRemoveVFs (:787-791, comment: erasing them directly would also remove the startVFs element); func.erase() runs only after the while loop exits (:821-823).

Chain-width accounting: numVFInMergedVF is initialized to 1 per VF (:697-700); pairs whose accumulated counts exceed mergeVFNumLimit are skipped before tryMerge (:753-770); on success the merged VF inherits the sum (:781-783).

Dependency-closure maintenance lives inside the rewrite: patchCalls writes allDepsClosure[newCall] as the union of call1/call2 closures (:1145-1150) and rewrites existing entries in place (:1152 onward) — the closure is updated during patchCalls, not by the outer loop.

Worklist termination: every path through the greedy loop body ends with scoreIdx++ (:731, :737, :749, :768, :811) — skip, pre-check reject, legality reject, and success all advance the same monotonic cursor.
